A map of the southern tip of Africa in the late 18th and early 19th century. The map shows the Cape Colony in the south-west, with an arrow pointing eastwards. In the south-east, another arrow points westwards. The two arrows meet at a shaded region and "Great Fish River". Clean flat textbook illustration, white background, distinct colours for Boer and Xhosa territories.

An illustration of a Voortrekker wagon train. Several heavy wooden wagons with canvas covers, pulled by teams of long-horned oxen, are travelling across a dry, grassy plain. Men with wide-brimmed hats and rifles sit on horses or walk alongside the wagons. A Khoikhoi servant is guiding the lead oxen with a whip. In the background, flat-topped mountains typical of the South African interior. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
